# Google's Antigravity CLI (docs/adapter-format.md): facts only, nothing in this file runs. Its own
# settings are ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json (model, agentMode, toolPermission, sandbox,
# permissions); MCP servers ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json (shared with the Antigravity IDE:
# command/args/env, or serverUrl for Streamable HTTP; no httpUrl, no SSE); skills
# ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills (and .agents/skills in a project). Sources:
# antigravity.google/docs/settings?tab=cli, /docs/mcp, /docs/skills, /docs/getting-started?tab=cli.
command = "agy"
name = "Antigravity CLI"
label = "Antigravity"
full_name = "Antigravity CLI"
icon = "U+F02AD"
installer = "agy"
offered = false                        # not in Omarchy's agent menu (only this app offers it)
spec = "antigravity-cli"
homepage = "https://antigravity.google"
data = ["~/.gemini/antigravity-cli", "~/.gemini/config", "~/.gemini/antigravity"]
home = "~/.gemini/antigravity-cli"
activity = ["~/.gemini/antigravity-cli"]
web_search = true                      # searches the web itself (Google Search grounding)

[[install]]                            # its release through mise (aqua, checksummed)
kind = "mise"
spec = "antigravity-cli"

[[install]]
kind = "installer"

[skills]                               # its own folder (and .agents/skills in a project)
dirs = ["~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills"]
own = "~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills"

[mcp]
path = "~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json"
shape = "antigravity"

[access]
how = "A Google account (free tier or Google AI plan), or a Gemini API key from aistudio.google.com"
login = "agy"
env = ["GEMINI_API_KEY"]

[[access.logins]]
label = "Google account"
argv = ["agy"]
note = "Choose “Sign in with Google” when it asks."

[security]
sandbox = "enableTerminalSandbox"      # the setting that is its sandbox
asks = "toolPermission"                # the setting that says when it asks first
file = "~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json"
format = "json"

[[security.settings]]
key = "toolPermission"
title = "When Antigravity asks"
explain = "Whether Antigravity asks before it runs a tool, such as a command or a file change."
default = "request-review"
recommended = "request-review"
terms = ["approval", "sandbox"]
choices = [
  { value = "strict", label = "Strict", explain = "Asks before every tool, even reading.", risk = 0 },
  { value = "request-review", label = "Ask first", explain = "Asks before it runs a command or changes a file.", risk = 1 },
  { value = "proceed-in-sandbox", label = "Go ahead in the sandbox", explain = "Runs commands in its sandbox without asking.", risk = 2 },
  { value = "always-proceed", label = "Never ask", explain = "Runs every tool without asking. Only for a throwaway machine.", risk = 3 },
]

[[security.settings]]
key = "agentMode"
title = "Agent mode"
explain = "How much Antigravity may do on its own. It can be changed for one session in the CLI."
default = "default"
recommended = "default"
terms = ["approval"]
choices = [
  { value = "default", label = "Normal", explain = "Follows “When Antigravity asks”.", risk = 1 },
  { value = "plan", label = "Plan only", explain = "Reads and plans; changes nothing until you agree.", risk = 0 },
  { value = "accept-edits", label = "Edit without asking", explain = "Edits files on its own, asks before commands.", risk = 2 },
  { value = "auto", label = "Automatic (preview)", explain = "Decides on its own which actions need your OK.", risk = 2 },
]

[[security.settings]]
key = "enableTerminalSandbox"
title = "Sandbox for commands"
explain = "Runs terminal commands in a sandbox."
default = "off"
recommended = "on"
terms = ["sandbox"]
choices = [
  { value = "on", label = "On", explain = "Commands are fenced in.", risk = 0 },
  { value = "off", label = "Off", explain = "Commands run with all your rights.", risk = 1 },
]

[[security.settings]]
key = "allowNonWorkspaceAccess"
title = "Files outside the project"
explain = "Whether Antigravity may read and write files outside the project folder."
default = "off"
recommended = "off"
terms = ["sandbox"]
choices = [
  { value = "off", label = "Project only", explain = "Stays inside the project folder.", risk = 0 },
  { value = "on", label = "Anywhere", explain = "May touch any file you can.", risk = 2 },
]

[[security.rules]]
key = "permissions.allow"
title = "Allowed without asking"

[[security.rules]]
key = "permissions.ask"
title = "Always ask"

[[security.rules]]
key = "permissions.deny"
title = "Never allowed"

[[security.rules]]
key = "trustedWorkspaces"
title = "Trusted folders"

# LM Studio Bionic (docs/adapter-format.md): facts only, nothing in this file runs. The app installs it
# with an installer of its own (install_ctl.Bionic); it always runs LM Studio's engine and models.
command = "bionic"
name = "LM Studio Bionic"
label = "LM Studio Bionic"
icon = "U+F09D1"
installer = "bionic"
short_version = true
offered = false
fixed_provider = "lmstudio"
self_served = true
homepage = "https://lmstudio.ai"
data = ["~/.lmstudio/apps/bionic"]
home = "~/.lmstudio/apps/bionic"
activity = ["~/.lmstudio/apps/bionic/conversations", "~/.lmstudio/apps/bionic/.internal/ng-sessions.sqlite"]
chat_app = true

[[install]]
kind = "installer"

[skills]
dirs = ["~/.lmstudio/skills"]
own = "~/.lmstudio/skills"

[mcp]
in_app = "Settings › Connected apps"

[access]
how = "Nothing: it runs models on this computer"
local_ok = true

[details]                              # always LM Studio's engine and models
reader = "lmstudio-app"

# Claude Code (docs/adapter-format.md): facts only, nothing in this file runs.
command = "claude"
name = "Claude Code"
label = "Claude"
full_name = "Claude Code"
icon = "U+F06C4"                      # Nerd Font glyph (the app draws its own SVG of it)
homepage = "https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code"
data = ["~/.claude", "~/.claude.json"] # its settings and sessions: never removed by the app
home = "~/.claude"
activity = ["~/.claude/history.jsonl", "~/.claude/projects"]
web_search = true                      # searches the web itself (no MCP server needed)

[[install]]                            # ways to install it, best first
kind = "mise"
spec = "claude"

[update]
self = ["claude", "update"]            # its own updater
latest = "claude-channel"              # a reader the app has: the newest version of its channel

[sessions]
reader = "claude-files"                # a reader the app has (~/.claude/projects)
note = "Numbers from Claude Code's session files (no text is read). The API value is what the tokens would cost at API prices, not what a plan costs."

[replies]                              # its session files: the map's usage statistics box
folder = "~/.claude/projects"
depth = 1
format = "claude-jsonl"
contexts = { "claude-opus-5" = 1000000, "" = 200000 }   # context size by model name beginning

[subagents]                            # its subagents (Task/Agent tool): the map's subagents page
format = "claude-projects"
path = "~/.claude/projects"

[skills]
dirs = ["~/.claude/skills"]            # read by the agent itself
own = "~/.claude/skills"               # where the app's links go

[mcp]
path = "~/.claude.json"
format = "claude"
shape = "claude"

[ask]                                  # one prompt, one answer, no tools (the chess page)
argv = ["claude", "-p", "--tools", "", "--strict-mcp-config", "--no-session-persistence", "{prompt}"]
games = ["chess"]                      # its menu offers Play chess
effort = { quick = ["--effort", "low"], normal = ["--effort", "medium"], deep = ["--effort", "high"], max = ["--effort", "max"] }   # Thinking time
note = "no tools, no MCP servers, no session kept"

[access]
logout = ["claude", "auth", "logout"]     # its own sign-out, in a terminal
how = "A Claude Pro or Max subscription (claude.ai), or an API key from console.anthropic.com"
login = "claude auth login"
files = [".claude/.credentials.json"]  # only whether one exists is checked, never read
env = ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"]

[[access.logins]]
label = "Claude subscription"
argv = ["claude", "auth", "login", "--claudeai"]

[[access.logins]]
label = "API billing (Anthropic Console)"
argv = ["claude", "auth", "login", "--console"]

[security]
sandbox = "sandbox.enabled"                  # the setting that is its sandbox
asks = "permissions.defaultMode"     # the setting that says when it asks first
file = "~/.claude/settings.json"
format = "json"

[[security.settings]]
key = "permissions.defaultMode"
title = "Permission mode"
explain = "How much Claude Code may do without asking. It can be changed for one session with Shift+Tab."
default = "default"
recommended = "default"
terms = ["approval", "classifier", "bypass"]
choices = [
  { value = "default", label = "Ask first", explain = "Asks before it edits a file or runs a command.", risk = 1 },
  { value = "plan", label = "Plan only", explain = "Reads and plans; changes nothing until you agree.", risk = 0 },
  { value = "dontAsk", label = "Only what is allowed", explain = "Never asks: does only what your allow rules permit and refuses the rest.", risk = 0 },
  { value = "acceptEdits", label = "Edit without asking", explain = "Edits files in the project on its own, asks before commands.", risk = 2 },
  { value = "auto", label = "Automatic review", explain = "A classifier lets safe actions through and asks about the rest.", risk = 2 },
  { value = "bypassPermissions", label = "Bypass all checks", explain = "Does everything without asking. Only for a throwaway machine.", risk = 3 },
]

[[security.settings]]
key = "sandbox.enabled"
title = "Sandbox for commands"
explain = "Runs shell commands in a sandbox (bubblewrap on Linux): writes only in the project, network only to allowed sites."
default = false
recommended = true
terms = ["sandbox", "network"]
choices = [
  { value = true, label = "On", explain = "Commands are fenced in.", risk = 0 },
  { value = false, label = "Off", explain = "Commands run with all your rights.", risk = 1 },
]

[[security.settings]]
key = "permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode"
warn = { title = "Bypass mode can be switched on", explain = "Starting it with --dangerously-skip-permissions switches every check off.", fix = "Block bypass mode." }
title = "Block bypass mode"
explain = "Makes it impossible to start Claude Code with --dangerously-skip-permissions, even by mistake."
recommended = "disable"
terms = ["bypass"]
choices = [
  { value = "disable", label = "Blocked", explain = "Bypass mode cannot be switched on.", risk = 0 },
  { unset = true, label = "Allowed", explain = "Bypass mode can be switched on with a flag.", risk = 1 },
]

[[security.rules]]                     # lists shown under the settings, one entry per line
key = "permissions.allow"
title = "Allowed without asking"

[[security.rules]]
key = "permissions.ask"
title = "Always ask"

[[security.rules]]
key = "permissions.deny"
title = "Never allowed"

# Its own setup commands, in a terminal tab (Configure… on the map)
[[configure]]
label = "Check its setup"
argv = ["claude", "doctor"]

[details]                              # its model and providers (the agent's card)
reader = "claude"

[models]                               # the online models the map can switch it to
reader = "claude"

[research]                             # a web look-up (Add skills, MCP, AI checks): only the two web tools, no session kept, the prompt on stdin
argv = ["claude", "-p", "--tools", "WebSearch", "WebFetch", "--allowedTools", "WebSearch", "WebFetch",
        "--strict-mcp-config", "--no-session-persistence", "--disable-slash-commands", "--output-format", "json"]
output = "claude-json"                 # the answer and its token use

[task]                                 # Do it with Claude…: in a terminal tab, it asks before each step
argv = ["claude", "{prompt}"]

[rewrite]                              # a skill rewritten for an MCP server: no tools at all, the prompt on stdin
argv = ["claude", "-p", "--tools", "", "--strict-mcp-config", "--no-session-persistence",
        "--disable-slash-commands", "--output-format", "text"]

[closed]                               # what closes it in when the map starts it (agent_guard)
background = ["--strict-mcp-config", "--settings", "{\"disableAllHooks\": true}"]   # look-ups, rewrites: their tools are in their argv; no hooks
# Task tabs: "ask" rules win over the user's own allow-list, so every command and edit is asked first; no hooks.
task = ["--permission-mode", "manual", "--strict-mcp-config", "--settings",
        "{\"disableAllHooks\": true, \"permissions\": {\"ask\": [\"Bash\", \"Edit\", \"Write\", \"MultiEdit\", \"NotebookEdit\"]}}"]

# OpenAI's Codex CLI (docs/adapter-format.md): facts only, nothing in this file runs.
command = "codex"
name = "Codex"
label = "Codex"
icon = "U+E905"
icon_font = "omarchy"
short_model_flag = true
homepage = "https://github.com/openai/codex"
data = ["~/.codex"]
home = "~/.codex"
activity = ["~/.codex/history.jsonl", "~/.codex/sessions", "~/.codex/state_5.sqlite"]
web_search = true                      # searches the web itself (no MCP server needed)

[replies]                              # its session files: the map's usage statistics box
folder = "~/.codex/sessions"
depth = 3
format = "codex-jsonl"

[[install]]
kind = "mise"
spec = "codex"

[subagents]
format = "codex-rollouts"
path = "~/.codex/sessions"

[sessions]
reader = "codex-files"            # a reader the app has (~/.codex/sessions)
note = "Numbers from {0}'s session files (no text is read). The API value is what the tokens would cost at API prices, not what a plan costs."
note_args = ["Codex"]

[skills]
dirs = ["~/.agents/skills", "~/.codex/skills"]
own = "~/.codex/skills"

[mcp]
path = "~/.codex/config.toml"
format = "toml"
key = "mcp_servers"
shape = "codex"

[ask]                                  # one prompt, one answer, no tools (the chess page)
argv = ["codex", "exec", "--sandbox", "read-only", "--skip-git-repo-check", "--ephemeral", "--color", "never", "{prompt}"]
games = ["chess"]                      # its menu offers Play chess
effort = { quick = ["-c", "model_reasoning_effort=low"], normal = ["-c", "model_reasoning_effort=medium"], deep = ["-c", "model_reasoning_effort=high"], max = ["-c", "model_reasoning_effort=high"] }   # Thinking time
note = "read-only sandbox, no session kept"

[access]
logout = ["codex", "logout"]     # its own sign-out, in a terminal
how = "A ChatGPT plan (Plus, Pro, Business), or an API key from platform.openai.com"
login = "codex login"
files = [".codex/auth.json"]
env = ["OPENAI_API_KEY"]
local_ok = true

[[access.logins]]
label = "ChatGPT plan"
argv = ["codex", "login"]

[access.key]
var = "OPENAI_API_KEY"
url = "https://platform.openai.com/api-keys"
stdin = ["codex", "login", "--with-api-key"]

[security]
sandbox = "sandbox_mode"                  # the setting that is its sandbox
asks = "approval_policy"     # the setting that says when it asks first
file = "~/.codex/config.toml"
format = "toml"

[[security.settings]]
key = "approval_policy"
title = "When Codex asks"
explain = "When Codex stops and asks before running a command."
default = "on-request"
recommended = "on-request"
terms = ["approval"]
choices = [
  { value = "untrusted", label = "Ask for everything but safe reads", explain = "Asks before every command that is not a known read-only one.", risk = 0 },
  { value = "on-request", label = "When it needs more", explain = "Works inside the sandbox on its own and asks when it needs to leave it.", risk = 1 },
  { value = "on-failure", label = "After a failure (old)", explain = "Asks only when a sandboxed command failed. Replaced by “When it needs more”.", risk = 1 },
  { value = "never", label = "Never", explain = "Never asks; what the sandbox allows simply happens.", risk = 2 },
]

[[security.settings]]
key = "sandbox_mode"
title = "Sandbox"
explain = "What commands Codex runs may touch."
default = "workspace-write"
recommended = "workspace-write"
terms = ["sandbox"]
choices = [
  { value = "read-only", label = "Read only", explain = "Commands may read, not write or go online.", risk = 0 },
  { value = "workspace-write", label = "Project folder", explain = "Commands may write in the project folder (and temp), nowhere else.", risk = 1 },
  { value = "danger-full-access", label = "No sandbox", explain = "Commands may do anything you can do.", risk = 3 },
]

[[security.settings]]
key = "sandbox_workspace_write.network_access"
title = "Network in the sandbox"
explain = "Whether commands in the project-folder sandbox may reach the internet."
default = false
recommended = false
terms = ["network"]
choices = [
  { value = false, label = "Off", explain = "No internet for commands (web search of Codex itself still works).", risk = 0 },
  { value = true, label = "On", explain = "Commands may download and upload.", risk = 2 },
]

[[security.rules]]
key = "projects"
title = "Trusted folders"
keys_where = { trust_level = "trusted" }

# Its own setup commands, in a terminal tab (Configure… on the map)
[[configure]]
label = "Check its setup"
argv = ["codex", "doctor"]

[details]                              # its model and providers (the agent's card)
reader = "codex"

[models]                               # the online models the map can switch it to
reader = "codex"

[research]                             # a web look-up (Add skills, MCP, AI checks): read-only sandbox, the answer as JSON
argv = ["codex", "--search", "exec", "--sandbox", "read-only", "--skip-git-repo-check", "--json", "--output-schema",
        "{schema}", "-"]                 # "-": the prompt on stdin, never in the process list
output = "codex-jsonl"                 # events: the answer and its token use

[task]                                 # Do it with Codex…: in a terminal tab, it asks before each step
argv = ["codex", "{prompt}"]

[rewrite]                              # a skill rewritten for an MCP server: read-only, the prompt on stdin
argv = ["codex", "exec", "--sandbox", "read-only", "--skip-git-repo-check", "--output-last-message", "{answer}", "-"]

[closed]                               # what closes it in when the map starts it (agent_guard)
background = ["--disable", "apps", "--disable", "plugins", "--disable", "hooks"]   # look-ups, rewrites: no connectors, plugins, hooks
task = ["--sandbox", "read-only", "--ask-for-approval", "on-request", "--disable", "apps", "--disable", "plugins",
        "--disable", "hooks"]           # task tabs: every change leaves the sandbox, so it asks first
mcp_off = ["-c", "mcp_servers.{name}.enabled=false"]   # each MCP server of its [mcp] file, off for the run
home_env = "CODEX_HOME"                # where its [mcp] file is when this variable moves its home

# GitHub Copilot CLI (docs/adapter-format.md): facts only, nothing in this file runs.
command = "copilot"
name = "GitHub Copilot"
label = "Copilot"
full_name = "GitHub Copilot"
icon = "U+F4B8"
homepage = "https://github.com/github/copilot-cli"
data = ["~/.copilot"]
home = "~/.copilot"
activity = ["~/.copilot/session-state"]
web_search = true                      # searches the web itself (no MCP server needed)

[[install]]
kind = "mise"
spec = "copilot"

[subagents]
format = "copilot-events"
path = "~/.copilot/session-state"

[skills]
dirs = ["~/.copilot/skills", "~/.agents/skills"]
own = "~/.copilot/skills"

[mcp]
path = "~/.copilot/mcp-config.json"
shape = "copilot"

[access]
how = "A GitHub Copilot subscription (github.com/features/copilot)"
login = "copilot  →  /login"
files = [".copilot/config.json"]
env = ["COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN", "GH_TOKEN"]

[[access.logins]]
label = "GitHub account"
argv = ["copilot"]
note = "Type /login in it."

[security]
asks = "defaultPermissionMode"     # the setting that says when it asks first
file = "~/.copilot/settings.json"
format = "json"

[[security.settings]]
key = "defaultPermissionMode"
title = "Permission mode"
explain = "How new interactive Copilot sessions start."
default = "manual"
recommended = "manual"
terms = ["approval", "classifier", "bypass"]
choices = [
  { value = "manual", label = "Ask first", explain = "Asks before writes and commands; reading is allowed.", risk = 1 },
  { value = "assisted", label = "Automatic review", explain = "An AI review approves what it judges safe and asks about the rest.", risk = 2 },
  { value = "allow-all", label = "Allow everything", explain = "Approves everything, like --allow-all.", risk = 3 },
]

[[security.rules]]
key = "trustedFolders"
title = "Trusted folders"
also = "~/.copilot/config.json"        # Copilot's managed file holds the list when the settings do not

[[security.rules]]
key = "allowedUrls"
title = "Sites without asking"
also = "~/.copilot/config.json"

[details]                              # its model (the agent's card)
reader = "copilot"

# Charm's Crush (docs/adapter-format.md): facts only, nothing in this file runs.
command = "crush"
name = "Crush"
label = "Crush"
icon = "U+F02D1"
short_model_flag = true
homepage = "https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush"
data = ["~/.config/crush", "~/.local/share/crush"]
home = "~/.config/crush"
activity = ["~/.local/share/crush"]

[[install]]
kind = "mise"
spec = "crush"

[sessions]
reader = "crush-db"                    # a reader the app has (each project's .crush/crush.db)
note = "The cost {0} itself reports for each session (it keeps no token counts that add up)."
note_args = ["Crush"]

[skills]
dirs = ["~/.config/crush/skills", "~/.config/agents/skills", "~/.agents/skills", "~/.claude/skills"]
own = "~/.config/crush/skills"
listed = { file = "~/.config/crush/crush.json", format = "json", key = "options.skills_paths" }

[mcp]
path = "~/.config/crush/crush.json"
key = "mcp"
shape = "crush"

[access]
how = "An API key for a provider, or a local LLM from the map"
login = "crush"
files = [".local/share/crush/crush.json"]
env = ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "OPENAI_API_KEY"]
local_ok = true
per_token = true                       # API keys only (its flat-rate models report no cost)

[[access.logins]]
label = "Inside Crush (it asks for a key)"
argv = ["crush"]

# Cursor CLI (docs/adapter-format.md): facts only, nothing in this file runs.
command = "cursor-agent"
name = "Cursor CLI"
label = "Cursor CLI"
icon = "U+E90D"
icon_font = "omarchy"
homepage = "https://cursor.com/cli"
data = ["~/.cursor", "~/.config/cursor"]
login_status = { argv = ["cursor-agent", "status"], no = "not logged in", yes = "logged in" }
home = "~/.cursor"
activity = ["~/.cursor/projects"]
web_search = true                      # searches the web itself (no MCP server needed)
herdr = "cursor"

[[install]]
kind = "mise"
spec = "cursor-agent"

[skills]
dirs = ["~/.cursor/skills", "~/.agents/skills", "~/.claude/skills", "~/.codex/skills"]
own = "~/.cursor/skills"

[mcp]
path = "~/.cursor/mcp.json"

[access]
how = "A Cursor account (cursor.com)"
login = "cursor-agent login"
files = [".config/cursor/auth.json"]
env = ["CURSOR_API_KEY"]

[[access.logins]]
label = "Cursor account"
argv = ["cursor-agent", "login"]

[security]
sandbox = "sandbox.mode"                  # the setting that is its sandbox
asks = "approvalMode"     # the setting that says when it asks first
file = "~/.config/cursor/cli-config.json"
format = "json"

[[security.settings]]
key = "approvalMode"
title = "Approval"
explain = "When Cursor CLI asks before running a command."
default = "allowlist"
recommended = "allowlist"
terms = ["approval", "classifier", "bypass"]
choices = [
  { value = "allowlist", label = "Ask unless allowed", explain = "Asks unless the command is in your allow list.", risk = 1 },
  { value = "auto-review", label = "Automatic review", explain = "A classifier on Cursor's servers runs safe calls and asks about the rest.", risk = 2 },
  { value = "unrestricted", label = "Run everything", explain = "Runs every command without asking.", risk = 3 },
]

[[security.settings]]
key = "sandbox.mode"
title = "Sandbox"
explain = "Runs commands fenced in to the workspace."
default = "disabled"
recommended = "enabled"
terms = ["sandbox"]
choices = [
  { value = "enabled", label = "On", explain = "Commands are fenced in.", risk = 0 },
  { value = "disabled", label = "Off", explain = "Commands run with all your rights.", risk = 1 },
]

[[security.settings]]
key = "sandbox.networkAccess"
title = "Network in the sandbox"
explain = "Which sites commands in the sandbox may reach."
default = "user_config_with_defaults"
recommended = "user_config_with_defaults"
terms = ["network"]
